name: @cg/dev-station
description: DEV-STATION-01 - `pnpm dev:station`: the current source in the browser, on the console's one origin (127.0.0.1:5174) and CG Bridge's own ports (5280, 7911, 6251/udp), with its own state folder. It stops nothing: a CG Bridge service on those ports is named and the launcher refuses. Plain zero-dependency ESM with no build step; the tests drive the same modules the command runs.
